semantics.candidate_rule: Exact candidate target/test result is referenced.
semantics.comparison_rule: Per-check byte/semantic/performance equivalence criteria are explicit.
semantics.allowed_rule: Known intended changes are explicitly declared and reviewed.
semantics.authority_rule: No-regression result does not itself release/deploy.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: all differences marked regression despite declared semantic profile
